description: This file defines the DiffFormatter class used for formatting diff outputs in the Drupal project, specifically within the Drupal Component Diff namespace.

classes.name: DiffFormatter
classes.description: A class to format Diffs in the Drupal Component Diff namespace, providing methods to output diffs in a classic format with customizable headers and context lines.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a Diff object into a string representation, processing edits and generating diff output.

methods.name: _block
methods.description: Processes a block of edits, outputting context, additions, deletions, or changes.

methods.name: _start_diff
methods.description: Begins capturing output buffer for diff formatting.

methods.name: _end_diff
methods.description: Ends output buffering and returns the captured diff string.

methods.name: _block_header
methods.description: Generates a header string for a diff block based on start positions and lengths.

methods.name: _start_block
methods.description: Outputs the start of a diff block if headers are enabled.

methods.name: _end_block
methods.description: Placeholder for ending a diff block (no implementation).

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Outputs lines with a specified prefix, used for context, added, or deleted lines.

methods.name: _changed
methods.description: Outputs changed lines, showing deletions followed by additions.
